SUMMARY
Waverley Road is a sought-after residential street in Liverpool, close to local amenities, parks, and with easy access to the city centre via road and public transport. The area offers a vibrant community feel with nearby shops, cafés, and green spaces.

DESCRIPTION
This charming two-storey apartment offers bright and well-proportioned living space in a highly convenient location. Situated on Waverley Road in the popular L17 postcode, the property provides approximately 44.7 m² (481 sq.ft.) of internal accommodation arranged over the Lower Ground and Ground floors.
The ground floor features a spacious open-plan kitchen, diner and living room, creating a versatile heart of the home ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. This bright space flows naturally and provides plenty of room for dining and seating areas. A vestibule provides access to the property. On the lower ground floor there is a generous double bedroom with ample room for a double bed and additional furniture, along with a modern shower room fitted with WC, wash basin and shower. The layout is practical and efficient, making excellent use of the available space. The property benefits from off-road parking and access to a communal garden, adding further appeal for convenience and outdoor space. It would suit professionals, couples or first-time buyers looking for a low-maintenance home with character.
Waverley Road is a sought-after residential street in Liverpool, close to local amenities, parks, and with easy access to the city centre via road and public transport. The area offers a vibrant community feel with nearby shops, cafés, and green spaces. A fantastic opportunity to acquire a well-presented flat in a prime L17 location - ideal for owner-occupiers or investors.
